title: When Gross Margins Matter

reader_summary.headline: In turbulent times, getting down to the fundamentals of how your business operates is critical.
reader_summary.overview: In turbulent times, getting down to the fundamentals of how your business operates is critical. One of the key metrics to understand is gross margins. This week, in an episode from June 2020, A16Z general partners Martin Casado, David George, and Sarah Wang, discuss all things gross margins.

thesis: The speakers argue that while high gross margins are critical for generating cash flow in mature software companies, early-stage startups often face ambiguity in classifying costs between variable infrastructure and fixed R&D. They illustrate that gross margins can change dramatically over a company's lifecycle, citing Workday's transition from 40% to over 70% margins as it matured, and warn that misclassifying variable costs like software licenses as fixed R&D expenses can lead to overestimating long-term profitability.
